questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of an A/B test?

options.text: Determine which variant yields higher conversion

questions.explanation: A/B testing compares two variants to see which performs better in terms of a chosen metric, usually conversion.

questions.prompt: Which metric is most appropriate to evaluate a typical conversion funnel?
questions.explanation: Conversion rate directly measures the success of the funnel, making it the standard metric for A/B tests.

questions.prompt: Which factor increases the required sample size for a statistically significant A/B test?
questions.explanation: Higher confidence and smaller effect size both demand larger samples to detect differences.
